compiled_state.title: [ticket CLI]: short ticket ID (8-char prefix) -> 'does not exist' error on transition/show
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 136f34b08f781c66e7446680f2b05c37d0c8ce2c

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

The ticket CLI should resolve short ticket ID prefixes (e.g., `3576-e7aa`) to their full UUID form (e.g., `3576-e7aa-490e-48a8`), matching the behavior of `ticket show` which successfully returns ticket data given only the 8-char prefix.

#### Actual Behavior

`ticket show <short-id>` succeeds (returns ticket JSON), but `ticket transition <short-id> ...` returns `Error: ticket '<short-id>' does not exist`. The prefix resolution works in show but not in transition/other mutation commands, forcing callers to look up and use the full UUID for all write operations.

### 6. Logs

```
Closing 3576-e7aa (current: open)
Error: ticket '3576-e7aa' does not exist
Closing 3378-9722 (current: in_progress)
Error: ticket '3378-9722' does not exist
```

Status retrieved via `ticket show 3576-e7aa` returned `open` correctly. Full UUID `3576-e7aa-490e-48a8` resolved successfully via transition.
